new_libraries.name: Akshara
new_libraries.author: Vagarth Gaurav
new_libraries.sentence: Lightweight Indic script renderer for microcontrollers.
new_libraries.paragraph: Renders Kannada, Tamil, Devanagari, Telugu, Malayalam, Bengali, and Gujarati text on any C99 target using pre-shaped .aks font files generated on the host. Zero malloc, ~100 bytes RAM per context. Works with GxEPD2, U8g2, Adafruit GFX, or any draw callback.
